english.disabledExtensions: PHP extensions known to be unavailable for this workspace. Composer config.platform entries set to false are also honored.
english.phpExecutablePath: Optional PHP executable used for version detection.
english.symfony.environment: Explicit Symfony environment used only for static conditional route discovery. Leave empty to include only unconditional routes; SoPHP never reads project dotenv files or boots the Kernel.
english.symfony.winstarRoutes.enabled: Run the bundled Winstar module route provider for this workspace. This explicitly executes the project's bin/php-runtime bin/console debug:router command when a Symfony route query needs runtime module routes.
english.languageServer.enabled: Enable the self-hosted PHP language server with precise diagnostics, type-aware completion, hover, signatures, navigation, references and safe refactoring. When this setting has no explicit value, SoPHP stays disabled if Intelephense is installed.
english.semanticProviders: Trusted semantic provider executables to run in isolated one-shot processes. Providers are never discovered from project files; process isolation limits failures but is not a security sandbox.
english.routeProviders: Trusted route provider executables for runtime or project-specific route sources. Providers use fresh isolated one-shot processes unless complete snapshot caching is explicitly enabled; providers are never discovered from project files.
english.diagnostics.disabledCodes: Diagnostic codes that the self-hosted PHP language server must not publish. Configuration changes apply to open PHP documents immediately.
english.diagnostics.severity: Severity overrides keyed by stable diagnostic code. Use off to suppress a code.
english.files.exclude: Glob patterns excluded from the SoPHP project index.
english.indexing.mode: Controls project indexing. onDemand loads project sources for project-wide operations; progressive prepares project reference facts in the background and falls back to on-demand scanning until ready; experimental also indexes dependencies.
english.indexing.referenceMemoryBudgetMiB: Soft process RSS budget for speculative background References preparation in progressive mode. Preparation pauses at the budget; References still use the complete on-demand path.
english.indexing.experimentalSourceOnlyReference: Experimental: with indexing.mode set to experimental, prepare project PHP source and reference facts in the background without indexing all dependencies. References fall back to the complete on-demand scan until preparation is ready.
english.indexing.maxFiles: Maximum number of project files to index.
english.indexing.maxFileSizeKb: Maximum PHP file size to index, in KiB.
english.indexing.maxTotalMb: Maximum total indexed source size, in MiB.
english.indexing.onStartup: Legacy startup indexing switch. Use indexing.mode instead.
english.imports.onPaste: Choose whether SoPHP resolves imports when PHP code is pasted.
english.imports.optimize.preview: Show a Preview/Apply flow before optimizing imports.
english.imports.sort: Sort imports by kind then FQN, or by FQN only.
english.generation.strictTypes: Add declare(strict_types=1) to newly generated PHP files.
english.experimental.refactoring: Enable experimental project-wide indexing and refactoring.
english.move.enabled: Update namespaces and semantic references when PHP files are moved within Composer PSR-4 paths.
english.move.preview: Preview namespace and proven reference changes before the Safe Move command applies one undoable workspace edit.
english.rename.enabled: Provide stable F2 Rename for PHP class-like declarations. Disable this when another PHP extension should own Rename.
english.rename.file: Controls renaming a matching PSR-4 PHP file. Use Shift+Enter in the Rename input to inspect the ordered file and text edits in VS Code's standard preview.
english.rename.phpDoc: Update semantic PHPDoc type references during Rename.
english.rename.stringReferences: Reserved for future string-reference support. SoPHP 0.3 never changes ordinary strings.
english.routeProviders.cacheUntilInvalidated: Reuse a complete route snapshot until provider, environment, watched PHP/YAML, or open-document invalidation.
english.indexing.onStartup.deprecation: Use phpCompanion.indexing.mode. Startup indexing is no longer supported.
